connector.name: Elementor MCP Agent
connector.registryDescription: Agency-grade MCP for WordPress Elementor - multi-site, safe edits, templates, versions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package elementor-mcp-agent. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mogacode-ma account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ELEMENTOR_MCP_SITES
env.description: JSON array of site objects. Each: {id, url, username, application_password}. See README.

env.name: ELEMENTOR_MCP_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Alternative: path to a JSON config file. README has the schema.

env.name: ELEMENTOR_MCP_DEFAULT_SITE_ID
env.description: Optional default site id when a tool is called without site_id.
